chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhal narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazee, from Mansur ibn Buzurg, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Awadd, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): If I marry a woman, is it permissible for me to have intercourse with her before I have paid her any part of her dowry? He said: Yes, it is merely a debt upon you.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to have sexual relations with a wife before paying her full dowry?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Isfabar, Imam al-Sadiq clarifies that the payment of mahr is a financial obligation rather than a condition for the validity of the marriage contract itself, meaning consummation is permissible even if the dowry remains unpaid. This ruling underscores the distinction between the essential pillars of nikah and the subsequent financial rights of the wife, establishing the unpaid mahr as a binding debt (dayn) that must be settled. This principle is foundational in Shia jurisprudence for determining the status of the wife during the interim period before full payment.
